task: Classify immune infiltration level in lung squamous cell carcinoma. Classes: low, medium, and high immune class, reflecting increasing immune cell presence within and around the tumor. Key H&E indicators include the density of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, stromal inflammatory infiltrates, and the prominence of lymphoid aggregates relative to tumor cellularity.

classes.0: Low immune class with minimal lymphocytic infiltration and scant inflammatory stroma.
classes.1: Medium immune class with a moderate inflammatory infiltrate involving tumor nests or adjacent stroma.
classes.2: High immune class with dense lymphocytic infiltration, prominent inflamed stroma, or conspicuous lymphoid aggregates.
